svg.title: Tailscale: a one-use invitation becomes a device identity
svg.desc: The repository sequence diagram with the managed-device tag anonymized. A ready, verified guest receives a one-use join key over the guest-agent channel, enrolls, and returns its device identity; temporary material is removed and the invitation is revoked.

g.text: Tailscale: one-use invitation, durable VM identity
OAuth client secrets remain on Proxmox.
Join-key consumption/revocation does not delete the device.
Lost join response: preserve pending record and inspect the
same proven VM generation before another enrollment.
